To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) semantic technologies can support journalists in content curation and content production tasks, (b) semantic technologies can be used to support journalists in the detection of relevant events and in the generation of storylines, and (c) a prototype of a newsroom content curation dashboard has been developed, and is available for evaluation.

we have developed a prototype of a content curation dashboard for the newsroom that is based on a semantic analysis pipeline that is able to extract events, named entities, temporal expressions etc. from incoming content and to cluster events for the purpose of creating storylines.

(1) the use of semantic technologies and semantic web services for content curation is feasible, (2) the prototype system can be used for a wide range of use cases in the newsroom and (3) the prototype can also be used to automatically detect and annotate events and to generate event-based storylines.
